name: The University of Osaka
description: The University of Osaka (English name changed from Osaka University in April 2025) is a national research university in Osaka Prefecture, founded in 1931 as Osaka Imperial University. Its main campuses are in Suita and Toyonaka.
whyIncluded: It offers undergraduate degrees taught entirely in English (Human Sciences and the International Undergraduate Program in Science), its medical degree is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications, and Japan is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 270 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.summary: Osaka publishes only a rough total, so this uses the national survey average for international students in the Kansai region: housing, food, transport and personal costs, 12 months a year.
livingCosts.notes: The University of Osaka publishes only a total (its prospective-student FAQ says about ¥100,000 a month for daily necessities, and about ¥100,000-120,000 including rent), not a breakdown. Figures are JASSO 2023 Lifestyle Survey of Privately-Financed International Students (令和5年度私費外国人留学生生活実態調査, table 7-4), Kinki region average monthly spending in ¥1,000s: housing 40 + utilities 7, food 32, commuting 4, personal = hobbies/leisure 7 + other daily costs 8. Excludes study/research costs (54, includes tuition) and insurance/medical (3).

programmes.name: School of Engineering
programmes.summary: Standard national-university tuition, the same for all students. The one-off ¥282,000 is the admission fee, paid once in year 1. Fees may be revised during your studies. Taught in Japanese.
programmes.notes: Standard national-university (MEXT) rate: tuition ¥535,800/yr (¥267,900 per half year), matriculation (admission) fee ¥282,000, same for undergraduate and graduate students. Entrance examination fee (¥17,000 undergraduate / ¥30,000 graduate) excluded. Admission guides say the amounts are provisional and a revised rate applies if fees are changed during enrolment, so not cohort-locked. Japanese-taught. 2024 and 2025 figures from the university-wide undergraduate admission guides for April 2024 (令和6年度 総合型・学校推薦型選抜) and April 2025 (令和7年度 一般選抜) entry.
